title: Chuck Lorre, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ EP Zoanne Clack, ‘A Different World’ Boss Felicia Pride Join Lineup for SIE Society’s Impact+Profit26 (Exclusive)
summary: In addition, entertainment-education pioneer Miguel Sabido has been tapped to receive the SIE Impact Entertainment Visionaries Award at the Dec. 7-8 conference, which will be held for the first time at USC Annenberg.
